title: Cofinal realization of scalar exceptional and compact-support systems
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation rings $R=\mathcal O_E$, $S=\mathcal O_L$, uniformizers $\pi,v$, and ramification index $e\ge1$, so $\pi S=v^eS$. Put $A_n=R/\pi^n$, $B_n=S/\pi^nS=S/v^{en}$, for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, with a fixed compactification $f=pj$, $j$ open and $p$ proper [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties, def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Work on fixed small pro-etale skeletons [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. For $D=R,S$ and $W=X,Y$, let $\mathscr N_D(W)$ be the full subcategory of the ordinary unbounded derived category of strict semilinear systems over $(A_n)_W$ or $(B_n)_W$ consisting of normalized systems with levels in $D^b_{ctf}$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus, def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility]. Normalized means that every transition-adjoint $N_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\to N_n$, or its $B$ analogue, is invertible for $m\ge n$. Write $\mathsf F_D\dashv\mathsf E_D$ for the specified compact-support/exceptional system adjunction, and $\epsilon_D^{\rm sys}$ for its counit, with the simultaneous enriched realizations of [lem-coef-finite-adjunction-diagram-realization, lem-coef-cartesian-section-adjoint-mates]. The $S$ functors here are retained at the levels $en$, with composite quotient transitions.

Use the completed coefficient sheaves $\widehat R_W,\widehat S_W$ and the derived-complete bounded constructible categories $\mathcal C_R(W),\mathcal C_S(W)$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Write $\mathcal R_{R,W}$ for coherent reduction, $\mathcal L_{R,W}$ for total derived limit after restriction to completed coefficients, and $\mathcal R_{S,W}^{(e)},\mathcal L_{S,W}^{(e)}$ for the corresponding functors on the retained $S/v^{en}$ systems [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Put $T_W=-\widehat\otimes_R^LS$, the strict-tower scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension], and use the canonical comparison $\chi$ of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison] with ordinary completed-sheaf derived tensor. Let $F_D=Rf_{!,D}\dashv G_D=Rf_D^!$ be the integral constructible adjunctions of [prop-coef-integral-exceptional-adjoint]. Let $\mathsf T^{(e)}$, $\alpha^{\rm sys}$ be the specified scalar-system functor and compact-support comparison of [lem-coef-ramified-scalar-system-transpose].

For $M\in\mathcal C_R(Y)$ put $N=\mathcal R_{R,Y}M$. There are specified natural isomorphisms
$$\mathcal L_{S,X}^{(e)}(\mathsf T_X^{(e)}\mathsf E_RN)\cong T_XG_RM,\qquad
\mathcal L_{S,X}^{(e)}(\mathsf E_S\mathsf T_Y^{(e)}N)\cong G_ST_YM,$$
$$\mathcal L_{S,Y}^{(e)}\mathsf T_Y^{(e)}N\cong T_YM,\qquad
\mathcal L_{S,Y}^{(e)}\mathsf F_S\mathsf T_X^{(e)}\mathsf E_RN\cong F_ST_XG_RM,$$
$$\mathcal L_{S,Y}^{(e)}\mathsf T_Y^{(e)}\mathsf F_R\mathsf E_RN\cong T_YF_RG_RM.$$
They use the actual reduction/limit units and counits, $\chi$, and restriction to the cofinal indices $en$, and preserve the specified total-limit projections and their scalar-extension adjoints. In particular $N$ and $\mathsf E_RN$ have uniform finite Tor intervals; $T_YM$ and $T_XG_RM$ belong to the indicated $S$-constructible categories, so all displayed integral functors are defined on them. Under these isomorphisms the total limit of $\alpha^{\rm sys}_{\mathsf E_RN}$ is precisely the compact-support comparison
$$\alpha_{G_RM}:T_YF_RG_RM\xrightarrow{\sim}F_ST_XG_RM$$
with the fixed compactification and finite-free normalization of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison]. All identifications are of the specified functors on morphisms, natural in $M$, not merely isomorphisms between their values. They identify the retained tower with the full $S/v^m$ tower through the canonical cofinal limit comparison.

proof.text: Obtain simultaneous normalized system, scalar, cofinal and adjunction preparation, including actual completion units and both uniform Tor bounds. The proper/open scalar-system comparison is invertible.

Construct source by cofinalX, tensor/limit of the inverse right-adjoint evaluation, and the inverse scalar-model realization. Construct target by cofinalX, scalarReductionY inverse, inverse upper right-adjoint evaluation, and the inverse upper completion unit. Construct scalarY by cofinalY and the inverse scalar-model realization. Construct supportSource by cofinalY, support applied to the inverse right-adjoint and scalar-reduction comparisons, then supportS.iso. Construct supportTarget by cofinalY, scalar applied to inverse right- and left-adjoint evaluations, then the inverse scalar model at compact support. These are compositions and whiskerings of natural isomorphisms. Their component equations are definitional except for distributing functorial maps over composition.

Fill all domain, quotient, completion, Tor and cofinal-normalization fields from the preparation. Apply the normalized proper/open support-comparison theorem to obtain the remaining comparison field for the explicitly constructed support identifications. Package the resulting Realization with the same Context and its already invertible alpha.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q131-9d0748082 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: PASS, no changes. The split has 0 new nodes and leaves the item statement and stmt_deps unchanged. I read every cited statement in full, and lines 80-86 of the source paragraph in main-20261015 lem-coef-rational-operations.proof.md. No cycle on this snapshot: no dependency of the item reaches the item, so the report's earlier 124-node cycle is gone. Step 1: residue-tor gives the interval for N. The prop specifies P=G_RM as L_X E_f R_Y M and gives the output interval [a-2d_X,b+2d_Y], with bound 0 for empty schemes. E_RN is normalized because E_f maps normalized systems to normalized systems. Effectivity then makes the counit R P->E_RN an iso levelwise, and evaluation conservativity makes it a system iso. Step 2: constructibility of scalar extension, chi (derived complete inputs), and the Tor bound with en>=m on finite-type k-schemes; M and P have uniform intervals, which checks the domains of G_S and F_S. Step 3: flat-term K-flat representative, K-flat change of rings, and an explicit reassociation whose two maps are mutually inverse and commute with the quotients. Chi is the unit of the full-tower limit. Arithmetic restriction (coordinate selection, p_n rho_e=p_en, rho_e u=u_e) passes to the retained tower. Step 4: displays 1-3 come from the step-1 counit, step 3, the retained E_S, and the full-tower limit in the integral exceptional prop. Step 5: compact support is L F R. Effectivity and conservativity make the counit at F R_X P an iso, and F_RP is constructible by lem-sf-integral-compact-support-constructible. Step 6: alpha^sys (proper projection followed by open identification, at levels en) is the same strict-tower composite that defines c_{F/E} on D^b_ctf. Naturality along the step-1 counit and chi identify its limit with alpha_{G_RM}, and no equality is inferred from evaluations alone. Edge cases checked: M=0, e=1, f=id, empty schemes, m not a multiple of e. The declared generic tool_uses are accepted (server review_split PASS); two of them are already stmt_deps. No SGA source is cited.
